reasoning: 驗證目標：倒轉的推進速率依三段階梯遞增——前 3 秒為 10 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 5 秒）、其後 7 秒為 20 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 10 秒）、之後為 60 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 30 秒），直到倒轉結束或到達緩衝區起點。關鍵情境條件：兩個換檔時點（第 3 秒、第 10 秒）。為什麼這樣切：驗證對象是這兩個邊界與三段速率，設計方法採邊界值分析；三段是同一觸發（持續倒轉）的連續結果，依 §5.7 併為一條 TC 的多條 ER。只驗總後退量而不驗分段，無法區分本條與「固定速率倒轉」的實作（§7），因此在每個換檔點量測。推進量的容差取自條文自身：讀取時刻落在 0.5 秒步進之間，誤差上界即該階的單次增量——3 秒時 30±5、10 秒時 170±10、15 秒時 470±30 秒；容差值全部由條文的增量導出，非估計值（§8.4.1）。與 090（快轉）的關係：兩條的速率階梯數值完全相同但方向相反，條款分列（`4872868` vs `4872874`），依 §8.2.1 各自覆蓋。速率階梯已完整寫在 Test Item 內，依 §4.5 不在 Input Test Data 重複。

tcs.tc_title: Rewind rate steps up at three and at ten seconds
tcs.test_item: The HU shall allow Rewinding in 10-second increments (5-second every 0.5 second) in audio content for the first 3 seconds, in 20-second increments (10-second every 0.5 second) for 7 seconds, and in 60-second increments (30-second every 0.5 second) thereafter until the Rewind function is ended or the beginning of the buffer has been reached
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer holds enough content that rewinding for 15 seconds does not reach the beginning of the buffer
5. Playback is positioned at a known point inside the buffer
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the playback position and start a stopwatch as Rewind is requested
2. Read the playback position 3 seconds after the request starts
3. Read the playback position 10 seconds after the request starts
4. Read the playback position 15 seconds after the request starts, then release the request
tcs.expected_result:
1. The rewind request is accepted from the known position
2. The playback position has moved back by 30 seconds of content, within one phase-1 increment (±5 seconds)
3. The playback position has moved back by 170 seconds of content in total, within one phase-2 increment (±10 seconds)
4. The playback position has moved back by 470 seconds of content in total, within one phase-3 increment (±30 seconds)
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
